meta.name: graphviz
meta.description: Create directed/undirected graphs using DOT language with automatic layout. Best for dependency trees, call graphs, package hierarchies, and module relationships requiring fine-grained edge routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 DOT 语言自动生成带布局的依赖关系图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码描述并渲染模块、调用或包的层级关系图
copy.tagline_en: Generate dependency graphs with automatic layout using DOT language
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to describe and render hierarchical graphs of modules, calls, or packages

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 DOT 语言生成有向图或无向图，自动布局，适合画依赖树、调用关系、包层级等。
howto.when: 当你想用代码画图，尤其是展示节点间关系（如依赖、调用）时，可以要求 Claude 生成 DOT 代码。

say.text: 用 DOT 画一个模块依赖图
say.note: Claude 会生成 digraph 代码

say.text: 画一个无向图表示网络拓扑
say.note: Claude 会使用 graph 和 -- 连接

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate directed or undirected graphs using DOT language with automatic layout, suitable for dependency trees, call graphs, and package hierarchies.
howto.when_en: When you want to create diagrams showing relationships (e.g., dependencies, calls) using code, ask Claude to generate DOT code.

say_en.text: Draw a module dependency graph using DOT
Draw an undirected graph for network topology
say_en.note: Claude will use graph and -- edges
